Despite these challenges, SPIC recorded healthy revenue growth in Q2 FY27 compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous year. However, rising input costs put pressure on margins and profitability. We will continue our focus on operational efficiency and cost optimization. We are also working closely with the government to ensure the timely availability of fertilizers to farmers. As an integral part of India's agricultural ecosystem, we remain committed to supporting the country's agricultural progress and the needs of its farming community. Fertilizer sector overview: India's 2026 southwest monsoon ended with a rainfall deficit of 12.6%, the weakest in over a decade and the fourth-lowest since 2001. The shortfall, attributed to an active El Niño pattern , added to the challenges facing the fertiliser industry amid global supply-chain disruptions. However, advance procurement and supply planning helped maintain availability, with fertiliser inventories reaching a two-year high ahead of the rabi season. Particulars – Standalone Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26 % H1 FY27 H1 FY26 % (Rs.cr) Total Income 365.8 263.3 38.9% 713.5 548.3 30.1% EBITDA (including Non- 28.6 14.0 103.8% 68.6 46.0 49.2% operating income) Margins (%) 7.8% 5.3% 250 bps 9.6% 8.4% 120 bps PAT 6.1 (4.8) - 20.6 4.8 326.9% Particulars – Consolidated Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26 % H1 FY27 H1 FY26 % (Rs.cr) Total Income 449.0 357.2 25.7% 891.0 704.1 26.5% EBITDA (including Non- 45.1 17.3 160.0% 104.0 46.3 124.6% operating income) Margins (%) 10.0% 4.9% 510 bps 11.7% 6.6% 510 bps PAT 7.8 (15.8) - 26.5 (22.9) - Commenting on the performance, Mr. Arvind Singhania, Chairman, Ester Industries said: Improvement witnessed in Q1FY27 continued during Q2FY27 with improving operating environment, higher realizations, increased throughput and a favorable product mix. Consolidated Total Income increased 25.7% Y-o-Y to ₹449.0 crores, while EBITDA more than doubled, rising 160% Y-o-Y to ₹45.1 crores. EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 10% from 4.9% in Q2FY26, reflecting improved operating performance and better business mix resulting from higher contribution of Value- Added products within Film segment and better realizations across product portfolio. PAT turned positive at ₹7.80 crores, compared with a loss of ₹15.8 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. The operating environment for the BOPET Film industry remained stable during Q2 FY27, with the US tariff- related disruptions witnessed in FY26, largely behind us. However, disruptions in crude oil supply and price fluctuations caused by war in West Asia are resulting into higher shipping costs and longer transit time which is adversely impacting working capital cycle. In Specialty Polymers, sales volume was 711 MT in Q2FY27 against 1,161 MT in Q2 FY26, however segment EBIT margin remained healthy at 33.9%. The Company's Total Income for H1 FY 2026–27 stood at Rs.11,143 crore, as against Rs.8,374 crore in the corresponding period of the previous year, registering a robust growth of 33%. corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: Choice International Limited Reports Strongest Quarter in its History, Clocking ₹379 Crore in Consolidated Revenue  The Board of Directors has recommended the issuance of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:1, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company.  Choice International recorded its highest-ever consolidated revenue of ₹379 crore in Q2FY27, representing a robust 33% increase over the previous year.  Consolidated net profit rose to Rs. 69.47 crores in Q2FY27, increasing 23% YoY, with a PAT margin of 18.3%.  Consolidated EBITDA stands at Rs. 130.63 crores, while maintaining a margin of 34.5%.  Choice Equity Broking received ₹900 crore from South Korea’s NH Investment & Securities to support MTF expansion and broader business growth.  Demat accounts rose 14% YoY to 13.78 lakh; assets under custody stood at ₹66,300 crore and MTF book at ₹463 crore.  Advisory businesses maintained a strong pipeline, with a government advisory order book of ₹710 crore and 24 IPO mandates involving estimated fundraising of ₹6,210 crore.  NBFC loan book stood at ₹935 crore with a continued focus on expanding retail lending. Mumbai, 2nd November 2026: Choice International Limited, a diversified financial services and consulting group, announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026: Particulars (₹ Mn) Q2 FY27 Q2 FY26 YoY Revenue from Operations 3,729 2,744 36% Other Income 62 97 -36% Total Income 3,790 2,841 33% Employee Benefit Expenses 1,121 772 45% Finance Costs 306 206 49% Depreciation and Amortization Expenses 62 40 56% Administrative and other Expenses 1,363 1,079 26% Total Expense 2,852 2,097 36% Profit Before Tax 938 744 26% Tax Expenses 244 180 36% Profit After Tax 695 565 23% PAT Margin 18.33% 19.88% EBIDTA 1,306 990 32% EBITDA Margin 34.47% 34.84% Commenting on the performance, Mr. Kamal Poddar, Managing Director, Choice International Limited, said: “Our strongest-ever quarterly performance reinforces our strategy of building complementary businesses around India’s growing investment, financing and development needs. As these businesses scale, our priority is to deepen customer relationships and make greater use of the Group’s shared distribution, technology and expertise to drive sustainable earnings. The ₹900 crore investment by NH Group is a significant step in this journey, bringing capital and international expertise to support our next phase of growth. We intend to build on this partnership to expand beyond retail broking and strengthen our institutional, wealth and asset management capabilities. Alongside our advisory businesses, these capabilities position Choice to serve customers through more stages of their financial journey, with disciplined capital allocation and execution guiding our expansion.” Key business developments Broking and Distribution: Choice added 1.73 lakh demat accounts, taking the total to 13.78 lakh, representing 14% year- on-year growth. Its distribution network comprised 218 branches, client assets under custody stood at ₹66,300 crore and the MTF book reached ₹463 crore. Following the quarter-end, Choice Equity Broking received ₹900 crore in its bank account, completing the strategic investment by NH Investment & Securities of South Korea. The funds will primarily support MTF expansion, while the partnership creates opportunities to strengthen capabilities across other financial services businesses. Wealth Distribution: Total AUM stood at approximately ₹6,047 cr

The Company also posted a PAT of ~₹3.9 crore in H1, a turnaround from H1 FY26. The timely execution of its order book, despite global supply chain bottlenecks, highlights ideaForge’s ability to scale operations and deliver on customer commitments without compromising on quality. During Q2 FY27, ideaForge successfully completed field testing of the ZOLT Hybrid UAV for long-range ISR capabilities of up to 100 km and 6 hours of endurance with indigenous EW resilience capabilities and a long-range MWIR payload. RDI funding is in the form of a long-term debt facility and a low interest rate. S H Kelkar announces Q2 & H1 FY2027 results H1 FY2027 Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 1,298.6 cr, higher by 14.5% EBITDA stood at Rs. 167.5 cr, EBITDA margins stood at 13.0% Mumbai, November 2, 2026: S H Kelkar and Company Limited (SHK), the largest Indian origin Fragrance and Flavour Company in India, has announced its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Q2 FY27 performance overview compared with Q2 FY26 − Revenues from operations at Rs. 636 crore as against Rs. 554 crore, up by 14.9% − EBITDA at Rs. 79 crore as against Rs. 53 crore o EBITDA margin at 12.5% as against 9.5% − PBT at Rs. 27 crore as against Rs. 12 crore, up by 125.0% − PAT at Rs. 15 crore as against Rs. 9 crore, up by 58.8% H1 FY27 performance overview compared with H1 FY26 − Revenues from operations at Rs. 1,299 crore as against Rs. 1,134 crore, up by 14.5% − EBITDA at Rs. 168 crore as against Rs. 126 crore o EBITDA margin at 13.0% as against 11.1% − PBT at Rs. 96 crore as against Rs. 49 crore, up by 96.3% − PAT at Rs. 60 crore as against Rs. 35 crore, up by 72.4% 1 Commenting on the Company’s performance and strategic direction, Mr. Kedar Vaze, Whole Time Director & CEO at S H Kelkar and Company Limited, said: “Our first-half performance has been encouraging. We remain focused on staying close to customers and strengthening our presence across the Fragrance and Flavour businesses. Having significantly strengthened our creative, technical and manufacturing capabilities, our priority now is to bring them together more effectively. This will improve customer responsiveness, accelerate execution and build commercial traction for growth across markets. Our long-term vision is to build Keva into a globally competitive, technology-led Fragrance and Flavour company. Continued research in proprietary molecules, formulation technologies and sustainable ingredients will be our differentiator, as we grow in confidence to expand in new geographies.” Commenting on the Company’s performance and financial priorities, Mr. Jagdish Agarwal, Group Chief Financial Officer at S H Kelkar and Company Limited, sai

corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: November 02, 2026 National Stock Exchange of BSE Limited, India Limited Floor 25, Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G, Towers, Dalal Street Bandra Kurla Complex, MUMBAI - 400 001 Bandra (E) MUMBAI - 400 051 Dear Sir/Madam, Company's Scrip Code in BSE : 543530 Company’s Symbol in NSE : PARADEEP ISIN : INE088F01024 Sub: Press Release - Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 With reference to captioned subject, we enclose a copy of the press release issued by the Company in connection with the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, for your information and record. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For Paradeep Phosphates Limited Sachin Patil Company Secretary Encl: As above Paradeep Phosphates Ltd Posts Q2 FY 27 Results: 02nd November, 2026, Bengaluru: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd (BSE: 543530, NSE: PARADEEP), one of India’s leading fertilizer companies announced its financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. In Q2 FY27, Revenue from operations increased by 7% YoY to ₹ 7,364 crore, EBITDA reduced by 38% YoY to ₹ 431 crore, PBT reduced 65% YoY to ₹ 164 crore and PAT stood at ₹ 122 crore, down 64% YoY. In H1 27, the Company has achieved a Turnover of Rs 13,488 Cr higher by 19%, EBIDTA of Rs 1173 Cr. Despite the global uncertainty, particularly sulphur pricing/ availability and impact of the Rabi notification is yet to be factored in, the company delivered the EBITDA/ton for H1 of INR 5866 vis a vis INR 5719 of H1 FY 26 . We have been able to achieve sales volume of 1 Mn in Q2 FY 27 and 2 Mn tons in H1 FY 27 despite subdued monsoon in the country. We continue to invest in expansion projects and our key expansion project of Phos Acid expansion (Phase 1) from 500,000 MTPA to 700,000 MTPA at Paradeep is on track. The public hearing for the environmental approval for the capex program at Paradeep has been completed and we are expecting to receive environmental approvals shortly The energy efficiency improvement project at Goa has been completed and the energy consumption has been optimized by 0.3 GCcal/MT of Urea. Looking ahead, we believe the global uncertainty will prevail and we will remain committed to deliver consistent performance through integrated supply chain and product mix optimization. About Paradeep Phosphates Limited Paradeep Phosphates Ltd (PPL) is one of India’s largest phosphatic fertilizer companies, with an annual capacity of 3.7 million MT across Paradeep (Odisha), Goa, and Mangalore. The company produces DAP, NPK grades (N-10, N-12, N-14, N-19, N-20, N-28), and Urea, and markets them under trusted brands Jai Kisaan Navratna and Jai Kisaan Mangala. PPL serves over 12 million farmers through 100,000+ retailers across 18 states in India, supported by strong backward integration, a robust logistics network, and ESG-driven growth. For further information, please contact: Investorrelations.ppl@adventz.com https://www.paradeepphosphates.com/
